brief.topic: A pre-post checklist for Instagram carousels

angle.title: 4 checks before you hit post
angle.why: A short checklist people keep for later

hook.slide2: Most flops fail at line one

slides.headline: Most flops fail at line one

slides.title: Read the cover at thumbnail size
slides.body: Shrink it to a thumbnail. If you cannot read it in one glance, enlarge the text.

slides.title: Make slide two pay off
slides.body: Skip the intro. Give the first useful thing on slide two.

slides.title: Cut every slide to one idea
slides.body: If a slide needs a paragraph, split it into two slides.

slides.title: Pick one call to action
slides.body: Save, send or answer. Choose a single ask and put it at the end.

cta.text: Save this for when you need it

captionPack.firstLine: Most posts lose people before slide two. Run these four checks first.
captionPack.keywordLine: A quick pre-post checklist for Instagram carousels: thumbnail test, slide two, one idea, one ask.
captionPack.body:
1. Read the cover at thumbnail size
2. Make slide two pay off
3. Cut every slide to one idea
4. Pick one call to action

Two minutes of checking beats an hour of redesigning later.
